product_metadata.title: Miles Kimball Floral Swirl Vinyl Elasticized Table Cover, 42 x 68 Inch Oval, Blue
features: New and improved design as of 8/31/18
description: Pretty floral swirl elasticized table covers have the elegance you love without the fuss, in easycare vinyl Elasticized table covers stay in place neatly with fleece backing and elasticized edges. Simply wipe clean with sponge or damp cloth. Small round floral table cover fits 40"44"dia., large round fits 45"56"dia., oval fits tables up to 42" to 68". Imported.
